name: io.github.versionpill/mcp
title: Version Pill
description: Product management, public changelog, and feature requests - 60 lean MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: key
environmentVariables.description: Your Version Pill API key (optional — OAuth is used otherwise). Get one at versionpill.com → Settings → API Keys

features: context tool: 8 modes (state/work/full/docs/smart/session/diff/story) with token-budget delivery
insights: velocity, 365-day heatmap, project pulse/health — PM analytics in one tool
task_op prioritize: RICE-scores and ranks the backlog by value-per-effort
brain_dump: end-of-session bulk complete/create/move in ONE call
batch: run up to 10 tools in parallel
Version-keyed edge caching — writes invalidate instantly, reads stay fresh and cheap
Agent memory + semantic search (brain) across all project knowledge
Cross-app notes/docs/journal (Snow Labs vault) and GitHub two-way sync
AI PM workflows: PRD, acceptance criteria, retro, changelog, and more
useCases: AI PM buddy in Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf
Manage roadmaps and ship releases from the terminal
Persist agent memory and session context across tools
Triage ideas, plan sprints, and generate PM docs

tokenEfficiency.description: Designed for minimal token usage in every interaction

smartFetching.context: mode: state (default) | work | full | docs | smart | session | diff | story; pass budget for token-capped delivery
smartFetching.bulk: save_task/save_epic/save_cycle accept items[] for bulk upsert
